Discovery workspace

How this folder works. Keep it short and up to date: it is the first thing a new team member reads.

Folders

  • 01 Discovery Management: plan, communication plan, access checklist, RAID log, decision log
  • 02 Client Inputs: the client's original materials, as received
  • 03 Meetings: transcripts and the running log of meeting summaries
  • 04 Stakeholders: who is who, influence and interest
  • 05 Context: project context canvas, AS-IS context, glossary
  • 06 Requirements: requirements register, open questions, constraints
  • _agent: records the BA Discovery Agent uses; don't edit by hand

Naming files

Start file names with the date, YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-10-24 Kick-off transcript.
